title: Why Do We Get Hiccups?
short_title: Why Do We Get Hiccups? (And How to Stop Them)
description: Why do we get hiccups, and why do they stop on their own? Here is the simple science of the diaphragm.
comment: What is your trick to stop hiccups? Tell me! 😄

scenes.text: Why do we get hiccups, and why do they stop on their own?
Under your lungs sits a big muscle called the diaphragm. It pulls down every time you breathe in.
Sometimes it gets irritated, maybe from eating fast or fizzy drinks, and it jerks suddenly.
Air rushes in, and your voice box snaps shut. That snap makes the hic sound.
Slow breathing, holding your breath for a few seconds, or sipping water can help reset it.
Most hiccups stop within minutes. If they last for days, see a doctor.
